# Amirkabir University of Technology <span class='zh-inline'>(阿米尔卡比尔理工大学)</span>

<img src="logos/amirkabir.svg" alt="Amirkabir University of Technology identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

Tehran's oldest technical university, where our matrix-library assignment came from — an AP1400-2 homework from Spring 2022.

> 德黑兰最古老的理工院校，我们的矩阵库作业就来自这里——2022 年春季的 AP1400-2 作业。

## Background (背景)

A public technological university in Tehran, founded in 1958 as Tehran Polytechnic (some sources trace roots to a 1928 academy), renamed after Amir Kabir in 1979. Its Computer Engineering Department began teaching in 1988.

> 德黑兰的公立理工院校，1958 年以“德黑兰理工学院”之名成立（部分资料追溯到 1928 年的技术学校），1979 年以 Amir Kabir 命名。计算机工程系 1988 年开始招生授课。

## Notable people (名人)

**Jalal Al-e-Ahmad** — influential Iranian writer and intellectual among its alumni. **Mohammad Reza Meybodi** — Professor Emeritus of Computer Engineering. The department established Iran's first computer-engineering PhD programme in 2002.

> **Jalal Al-e-Ahmad** — 该校校友，伊朗有影响力的作家与知识分子。**Mohammad Reza Meybodi** — 计算机工程荣休教授。该系于 2002 年设立伊朗首个计算机工程博士项目。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

AP1400-2 Advanced Programming (the source of project 023). M.Sc. tracks include computer architecture/networks, software systems, artificial intelligence and robotics.

> AP1400-2 高级编程（项目 023 的来源）。硕士方向包括计算机体系结构/网络、软件系统、人工智能与机器人。
